app.tagline: AI writing actions in any app

errors.missingKey: No API key found. Open Settings › Provider & API and enter your key.
errors.config: The request was rejected. This usually means the API key is invalid or restricted, or the model/settings are incorrect.
errors.model: The configured model does not exist or is not available for this key. Pick another one in Provider & API.
errors.rate: You exceeded your API quota. Wait a moment or check your billing.
errors.server: The provider returned a temporary error. Please retry.
errors.timeout: The provider took too long to answer. Retry or raise the timeout in General.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your internet connection, corporate proxy or base URL.
errors.empty: The model returned no text (it may have been blocked by safety filters).

general.soundsDesc: Short sounds when an action succeeds or fails.
general.autostartDesc: Starts minimized to the tray when you sign in.
general.targetLanguageDesc: Used by the direct Translate shortcut. The palette lets you change it each time.
general.historyDesc: Stores input and result locally (SQLite) so you can look them up. Turning it off deletes the existing history. Usage metrics (no text) are always kept.
general.proxyDesc: Leave empty to use the system proxy. E.g. http://proxy.company:8080
general.autoUpdateDesc: Only notifies; installing happens when you click About › Install.
general.minimizeToTrayDesc: Minimize and close hide the window in the tray; KokoroKaku keeps running and shortcuts stay active. When off, closing quits the app.

provider.welcomeBody: To get started, pick a provider and enter your API key. Then select text in any app and press {{shortcut}}.
provider.openaiDesc: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI/corporate gateway, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, Ollama or LM Studio (local, your text never leaves the machine).
provider.apiKeyDesc: Stored in the OS credential vault (Windows Credential Manager / Secret Service on Linux). Never written to a file or sent to the UI.

shortcuts.popupDesc: Select text in any app and press this shortcut to open the palette next to the cursor. With nothing selected the palette opens empty so you can type or paste.
shortcuts.directDesc: Apply the action to the selection and replace it right away, without the palette. Use Ctrl+Z in the app to undo.
shortcuts.needsModifier: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win together with the key.
shortcuts.pausedDesc: No global shortcut is active. Resume from the tray or here.
shortcuts.tipAltGr: Avoid Ctrl+Alt+letter: on many European layouts it equals AltGr and can block characters.
shortcuts.tipClipboard: KokoroKaku briefly uses the clipboard to copy and paste; your previous (text) clipboard is restored right after.
shortcuts.waylandBody: Wayland blocks global shortcuts and keyboard simulation. Create GNOME/KDE shortcuts that run:

actionsTab.desc: Choose which actions appear in the palette and customise their prompts.
actionsTab.customPromptDesc: Must contain "CRITICAL:" (the guard against instructions inside the text); otherwise the default is used. {targetLanguage} is replaced with the language.
actionsTab.invalid: Missing "CRITICAL:" — the default prompt will be used.

dashboard.empty: No usage recorded yet. Select some text and press a shortcut to get started.
dashboard.pricingDesc: Used only for the cost estimate. Check your provider's pricing page.

history.disabledBody: Turn it on in General › Privacy to keep inputs and results.

about.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
about.privacyBody: No telemetry. Selected text goes only to the provider you configured. Keys live in the OS vault; history and metrics stay on this computer.
about.license: Free software under the MIT license.

popup.placeholder: Nothing selected — type or paste some text…
popup.noTarget: No source selection: the result will be copied.
